fullDescription: Gising! is a bold, high-energy emergency monitoring dashboard style characterized by a deep dark-mode aesthetic, vibrant red and orange gradients, and urgent micro-interactions. It features a seismic grid background pattern, radial glows for depth, and 'scanline' flicker animations. The typography pairs the geometric 'Clash Grotesk' for high-impact headings with the clean 'Satoshi' for data-heavy UI. This style is ideally suited for real-time monitoring apps, fintech dashboards, security platforms, and any interface requiring an atmosphere of precision and urgency.

structured.summary: A high-intensity, dark-mode monitoring interface with a technical, data-driven aesthetic using red and orange neon accents, staggered fade-in animations, and pulsing status indicators.

style.description: The style essence is 'Modern Emergency-Ops'. It uses a primary color palette of #ff2d55 (Red) and #ff6a00 (Orange) against a rich black (#0a0608) background. Typography utilizes Clash Grotesk for headings (700 weight, tight letter-spacing) and Satoshi for body text. Elements are layered over a 28px seismic grid with radial glows (rgba(255,45,85,0.18)). Micro-interactions include ripple pulse rings for active alerts and a 6-second looping scanline overlay.
style.prompt: Apply a dark-mode theme with background #0a0608. Overlay a subtle grid pattern (1px lines, 28px spacing) in color rgba(255,45,85,0.04). Use 'Clash Grotesk' for headers and 'Satoshi' for body. Primary accent: linear-gradient(110deg, #ff2d55, #ff6a00). Secondary text: #ff9ab0. Muted text: #6b3345. Card backgrounds: #130b0e with 1px borders of #2e1520. Implement a 'scanline' effect: a 2px horizontal line (rgba(255,45,85,0.07)) that slides from top to bottom every 6s. Use staggered fade-up animations (0.48s duration, 18px offset) for all container entries. Status indicators must use a pulse ripple animation (scaling from 1 to 2.6, opacity 0.7 to 0) with a 2.2s loop.

layout_and_structure.description: A vertically scrollable dashboard layout optimized for mobile viewing, featuring a sticky header, status summary widgets, and prioritized data cards.

prompts.prompt: Sticky header with 56px height. Left side contains a 36x36px logo icon with #ff2d55 shadow and a greeting label ('Good morning, [Name]'). Right side contains a 40x40px notification bell in a #130b0e card with a #ff2d55 blinking notification dot.

A high-visibility horizontal bar with background rgba(255,45,85,0.1) and 1px border of rgba(255,45,85,0.28). Includes a pulsing radio icon on the left and bold uppercase text indicating 'ACTIVE ALERTS'.

A horizontally scrollable row of 110px wide cards. Primary 'Active' card uses a red/orange gradient tint background. Other cards use #130b0e background. Each card contains a 14px Lucide icon, a 30px bold number in Clash Grotesk, and a small 10px uppercase label.

Vertical list of cards. 'High' priority cards use background linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255,45,85,0.14), rgba(255,45,85,0.05)) with a #ff2d55 border. They must feature a large icon shell (40x40px) with double-ring pulse animations. Content includes a Mag/Level header, location subheader, and metadata row (coordinates/depth). Bottom includes a full-width 'Full Details' button and a share icon.

A list of 'pill' style rows. Each row is 1px bordered with a 32x32px icon on the left. Right side contains a status indicator (e.g., green dot for 'Safe', red pulsing dot for 'Alert') with 10px bold uppercase text.

A vertical timeline container with #130b0e background and 1px borders. Individual items are separated by #2e1520 borders. Each item has a 3px thick left-border 'indicator' (Red for alert, Orange for warning, Grey for info). Each row displays an icon, title, subtitle, and relative timestamp (e.g., '2m ago').

special_ui_components.description: Dynamic pulse animation used for high-urgency alerts.
special_ui_components.prompt: Create two concentric 1.5px borders. Animate using @keyframes ripple { 0% { transform: scale(1); opacity: 0.7; } 100% { transform: scale(2.6); opacity: 0; } }. Set duration to 2.2s. Apply alert-ring-2 with a 0.75s delay. Color: rgba(255,45,85,0.6).

special_ui_components.description: Small status pills for severity categorization.
special_ui_components.prompt: Capsule shape, padding 2px 8px. Font: Clash Grotesk, 9px, weight 700. Red badge (High): BG rgba(255,45,85,0.2), Border 1px solid rgba(255,45,85,0.5), Text #ff2d55. Orange badge (Medium): BG rgba(255,106,0,0.18), Border 1px solid rgba(255,106,0,0.45), Text #ff6a00.

special_ui_components.description: Primary action button with internal bevel effect.
special_ui_components.prompt: Background: linear-gradient(110deg, #ff2d55, #ff6a00). Box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(255,45,85,0.45), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.12). Border-radius: 12px. Font: Clash Grotesk, 700 weight. Use flexbox to center Lucide icon and text with 6px gap.
